purpose: Offline calibration of Policy RAG retrieval with REAL local embeddings (Phase 3 workstream 3.3). Not a model-quality benchmark; no acceptance targets are implied.
deidentification: Contains no personal data: no employee names, ids, emails or HR records. Questions were authored against the synthetic demo policy corpus below. Must be re-reviewed before adding questions derived from real employee queries.
limitations: Small: 24 short policies (19 are one sentence long) and 80 questions authored by engineering, not by HR or employees.
Hard negatives (questions on topics adjacent to a policy but not answered by it) cannot be separated by a retrieval threshold; they must be refused by the answer layer and are reported separately.
English only; no typos, abbreviations or multi-turn context.
split_rule: Fixed per case ('calibration' or 'holdout'); thresholds may only be chosen on 'calibration' and are reported on 'holdout'.
